title: Recording: Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him, Woman, Dear Yoko by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 29 August 1980.

This was an overdub session for keyboards player George Small. He worked on three songs: ‘Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him’, ‘Woman’, and ‘Dear Yoko’.
